latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor Enhancer — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release: Instantly edit and enhance your video footage using cloud AI—no manual sliders or editing skills needed.
- Supports uploading raw video files up to 500MB in formats like MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM.
- Simple text instructions (e.g., “stabilize footage, boost colors”) trigger powerful enhancements and 1080p exports.
- Handles all rendering remotely with fast, GPU-powered processing; no installation required.
- Built-in session management and automatic token handling for quick, seamless setup.
- Includes clear API error handling, status reporting, and workflow guidance for creators and marketers.
